Thuja Tuya; White Cedar. Profile Thuja consists of the fresh leaves and twigs of Thuja occidentalis (Cupressaceae). It is included in some topical preparations for warts and in herbal antiseptic preparations. It is also used in herb- al preparations for respiratory-tract disorders. The oil distilled from the leaves and twigs is known as thuja oil or cedar leaf oil. It has been included in preparations for inhala- tion for the relief of respiratory-tract symptoms and for external use but is generally considered to be too toxic for internal use. Cedar leaf oil should be distinguished from cedar wood oil, ob- tained from Juniperus virginiana (see Red Cedar, p.2278). Homoeopathy. Thuja has been used in homoeopathic medi- cines under the following names: Thuja occidentalis. Preparations Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Chile: Thujaderm.
